content.short: MoonBlast is a multi-chain EVM memecoin launchpad for one-click token creation.
content.description: MoonBlast creates tokens across several EVM chains including Monad from a single interface, removing the contract deployment step entirely. Launchpads competing across chains rather than within one are betting that creators follow attention wherever it moves, which so far they have.
content.meta: One-click token creation across Monad, Base, BNB Chain and other EVM networks.
